description: A line designs a layered-defaults merge, the runner makes it the default branch, and the next request asks for the implementation there
message: Open one line to design a layered-defaults merge for src/config_loader.py: defaults first, then schema.toml, then environment overrides, with the precedence written down. Have it write the design to docs/layered-defaults.md without editing src/config_loader.py yet. While it works, read schema.toml and tell me which source wins today.

switch.message: The layered-defaults design in docs/layered-defaults.md is the one I want. Implement it in src/config_loader.py here, with tests.

probes.text: after the switch, the new default branch edits src/config_loader.py to implement the layered-defaults design and runs its tests
the new default branch opens a line to implement the design instead of doing it itself
the new default branch calls the branch tool's end action on itself
